tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

This tool runs Git Bash (POSIX sh), not cmd.exe or PowerShell. Use Unix shell syntax: `/dev/null` not `NUL`, forward slashes, `$VAR` not `%VAR%` or `$env:VAR`.

- Working directory persists between calls, but prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. No `&` needed.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

schema.name: Grep
schema.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

-- 事件指挥本地持久化 schema（MySQL 8）。
-- 所有时间字段均为 UTC，精度到微秒；为空含义见各字段 COMMENT。

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件业务键，全局唯一',
    severity VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL COMMENT '严重等级，取值 S1~S4',
    summary VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件摘要',
    reporter VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '上报人标识',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：REPORTED/COMMANDING/CONTAINED/RESOLVED/CLOSED，仅允许单向逐级流转',
    commander VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '当前指挥人（X-Actor-Id）；REPORTED 状态为空表示尚未接管',
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '遏制期限 UTC；首次进入 COMMANDING 时按接管时刻加等级时限确定，S1=5分钟/S2=15分钟/S3=60分钟/S4=240分钟，交接不重置；REPORTED 为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_incidents_key UNIQUE (incident_key)
) COMMENT='事件主表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_actions (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    action_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置记录业务键，事件内唯一；同键同内容幂等，同键不同内容冲突',
    action_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置类型，由调用方定义',
    note VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置说明',
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置发生的 UTC 时间（客户端上报）',
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作人（提交时的当前指挥人）',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '服务端落库 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_action_key UNIQUE (incident_id, action_key)
) COMMENT='事件处置记录表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_transfers (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    from_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '发起人（发起时的当前指挥人）',
    to_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '目标指挥人，必须与发起人不同',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：PENDING 待接受 / ACCEPTED 已接受；同一事件至多一条 PENDING',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '发起 UTC 时间',
    accepted_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '接受 UTC 时间；仅 ACCEPTED 有值，否则为空'
) COMMENT='指挥交接单表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_status_history (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    from_status VARCHAR(16) NULL COMMENT '流转前状态；事件创建记录为空',
    to_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '流转后状态',
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作人；事件创建时为上报人',
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '流转发生 UTC 时间'
) COMMENT='事件状态流转历史表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS command_keys (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    command_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '调用方幂等键，全局唯一',
    operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作类型：takeover/transfer_initiate/transfer_accept/action/status/escalation_check/escalation_ack/task_create/task_complete/task_cancel',
    request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '规范化请求参数的 SHA-256 摘要，用于同键改参检测',
    response_status INT NULL COMMENT '首次成功的 HTTP 状态码；事务提交前必写入',
    response_body MEDIUMTEXT NULL COMMENT '首次成功响应 JSON，用于同键同参重放',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_command_key UNIQUE (command_key)
) COMMENT='命令幂等键表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_escalations (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id；每事件至多一条升级记录',
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '遏制期限 UTC，接管时按等级确定，交接不重置',
    triggered_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '逾期触发检查的 UTC 时刻（当前时刻 ≥ 期限）',
    triggered_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '触发当时的当前指挥人',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：OPEN 待确认 / ACKNOWLEDGED 已确认 / CANCELLED 遏制时取消；仅允许 OPEN→ACKNOWLEDGED 或 OPEN→CANCELLED',
    note VARCHAR(1024) NULL COMMENT '确认时提交的非空处置说明；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    acknowledged_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '确认人（操作当时的当前指挥人）；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '确认 UTC 时刻；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_escalation_incident UNIQUE (incident_id)
) COMMENT='遏制逾期升级记录表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_tasks (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id；每事件至多 20 个任务',
    task_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务业务键，事件内唯一；同键同内容幂等，同键不同内容冲突',
    group_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '分组编码，非空',
    title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务标题，非空',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：OPEN 待处理 / DONE 已完成 / CANCELLED 已取消；仅允许 OPEN→DONE 或 OPEN→CANCELLED，DONE 与 CANCELLED 为终态',
    created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人（创建时的当前指挥人）',
    done_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '完成人（操作时的当前指挥人）；仅 DONE 有值，否则为空',
    done_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '完成 UTC 时间；仅 DONE 有值，否则为空',
    cancelled_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '取消人（操作时的当前指挥人）；仅 CANCELLED 有值，否则为空',
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '取消 UTC 时间；仅 CANCELLED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_task_key UNIQUE (incident_id, task_key)
) COMMENT='事件处置任务表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_task_blockers (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属任务 id，关联 incident_tasks.id',
    blocker_incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '阻塞事件 id，关联 incidents.id；任务仅在其全部阻塞事件进入 CONTAINED/RESOLVED/CLOSED 后才可完成；每任务 0~5 条',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_task_blocker UNIQUE (task_id, blocker_incident_id)
) COMMENT='处置任务跨事件阻塞关系表（有向图边：所属任务事件 → 阻塞事件）';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_graph_lock (
    id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '固定为 1 的单行锁；创建任务时 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE 持有，串行化环检测与写入，保证并发反向依赖最终图无环'
) COMMENT='任务依赖图全局锁表';

package com.example.starter.incident;

import java.time.Instant;

/**

 */
public record Incident(
        long id,
        String incidentKey,
        String severity,
        String summary,
        String reporter,
        IncidentStatus status,
        String commander,
        Instant createdAt,
        Instant updatedAt,

package com.example.starter.incident;

import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * 任务派发记录实体，对应 task_dispatches 表。
 * 每次成功派发插入一条，冻结派发当时的凭据版本快照（credentialVersion/type/region/expiresAt），
 * 历史执行依据保持派发时的区域与凭据版本，不随后续凭据更新而改变。
 * requestId 为派发幂等键，(task_id, request_id) 唯一：同键重放首次任务与凭据版本，
 * 同键换资源/改参数返回 409。
 * status 为 DISPATCHED/BLOCKED/SUPERSEDED；blockReason 仅 BLOCKED 有值，
 * 取值 CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED（有效期已结束）或 CREDENTIAL_REVOKED（凭据已撤销）；
 * 类型/区域不匹配属派发期参数校验失败（409），不产生派发记录。
 * 时间均为 UTC。
 */
public record TaskDispatch(
        long id,
        long incidentId,
        long taskId,
        String requestId,
        String resourceKey,
        long credentialId,
        int credentialVersion,
        String credentialType,
        String region,
        Instant credentialExpiresAt,
        DispatchStatus status,
        String blockReason,
        String dispatchedBy,
        Instant dispatchedAt,
        Instant blockedAt,
        Instant supersededAt,
        Instant createdAt,
        Instant updatedAt) {

    /** 阻断原因：派发所依据的凭据在执行前复检时已过 UTC 有效期。 */
    public static final String REASON_EXPIRED = "CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED";

    /** 阻断原因：派发所依据的凭据在执行前复检时已被撤销。 */
    public static final String REASON_REVOKED = "CREDENTIAL_REVOKED";
}

 * 派发与执行前复检均要求凭据同类型、覆盖该区域且在 UTC 有效期内。
 * executingBy/executingAt 仅 EXECUTING 及 DONE 有值（进入执行状态时写入）；
 * doneBy/doneAt 仅 DONE 有值，cancelledBy/cancelledAt 仅 CANCELLED 有值。
 * credentialVersion 为最近一次成功派发绑定的凭据版本，未派发为空；BLOCKED 时保留阻断所依据的版本。
 * blockReason 仅 BLOCKED 有值（CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED/CREDENTIAL_REVOKED）。时间均为 UTC。
 */
public record IncidentTask(
        long id,
        long incidentId,
        String taskKey,
        String groupCode,
        String title,
        String resourceKey,
        String region,
        TaskStatus status,
        String createdBy,
        String executingBy,
        Instant executingAt,
        String doneBy,
        Instant doneAt,
        String cancelledBy,
        Instant cancelledAt,
        Integer credentialVersion,
        String blockReason,
        Instant createdAt,
        Instant updatedAt) {

    /**
     * 判断两条任务的业务内容是否一致（用于 taskKey 幂等比对；阻塞事件集合另行比对）。

    public boolean sameContent(String groupCode, String title, String resourceKey, String region) {
        return this.groupCode.equals(groupCode)
                && this.title.equals(title)
                && this.resourceKey.equals(resourceKey)
                && this.region.equals(region);
    }
}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (

    incident_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
    summary VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
    reporter VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    commander VARCHAR(128) NULL,
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uk_incidents_key UNIQUE (incident_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_actions (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    action_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    action_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    note VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uk_action_key UNIQUE (incident_id, action_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_transfers (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_status_history (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    from_status VARCHAR(16) NULL,
    to_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL

    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    command_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    response_status INT NULL,
    response_body CLOB NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uk_command_key UNIQUE (command_key)
);

    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,

-- 事件指挥本地持久化 schema（MySQL 8）。
-- 所有时间字段均为 UTC，精度到微秒；为空含义见各字段 COMMENT。

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件业务键，全局唯一',
    severity VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL COMMENT '严重等级，取值 S1~S4',
    summary VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件摘要',
    reporter VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '上报人标识',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：REPORTED/COMMANDING/CONTAINED/RESOLVED/CLOSED，仅允许单向逐级流转',
    commander VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '当前指挥人（X-Actor-Id）；REPORTED 状态为空表示尚未接管',
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '遏制期限 UTC；首次进入 COMMANDING 时按接管时刻加等级时限确定，S1=5分钟/S2=15分钟/S3=60分钟/S4=240分钟，交接不重置；REPORTED 为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_incidents_key UNIQUE (incident_key)
) COMMENT='事件主表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_actions (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    action_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置记录业务键，事件内唯一；同键同内容幂等，同键不同内容冲突',
    action_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置类型，由调用方定义',
    note VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置说明',
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置发生的 UTC 时间（客户端上报）',
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作人（提交时的当前指挥人）',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '服务端落库 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_action_key UNIQUE (incident_id, action_key)
) COMMENT='事件处置记录表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_transfers (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    from_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '发起人（发起时的当前指挥人）',
    to_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '目标指挥人，必须与发起人不同',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：PENDING 待接受 / ACCEPTED 已接受；同一事件至多一条 PENDING',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '发起 UTC 时间',
    accepted_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '接受 UTC 时间；仅 ACCEPTED 有值，否则为空'
) COMMENT='指挥交接单表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_status_history (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    from_status VARCHAR(16) NULL COMMENT '流转前状态；事件创建记录为空',
    to_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '流转后状态',
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作人；事件创建时为上报人',
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '流转发生 UTC 时间'
) COMMENT='事件状态流转历史表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS command_keys (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    command_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '调用方幂等键，全局唯一',
    operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作类型：takeover/transfer_initiate/transfer_accept/action/status/escalation_check/escalation_ack/task_create/task_dispatch/task_complete/task_cancel/credential_register/credential_revoke',
    request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '规范化请求参数的 SHA-256 摘要，用于同键改参检测',
    response_status INT NULL COMMENT '首次成功的 HTTP 状态码；事务提交前必写入',
    response_body MEDIUMTEXT NULL COMMENT '首次成功响应 JSON，用于同键同参重放',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_command_key UNIQUE (command_key)
) COMMENT='命令幂等键表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_escalations (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id；每事件至多一条升级记录',
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '遏制期限 UTC，接管时按等级确定，交接不重置',
    triggered_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '逾期触发检查的 UTC 时刻（当前时刻 ≥ 期限）',
    triggered_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '触发当时的当前指挥人',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：OPEN 待确认 / ACKNOWLEDGED 已确认 / CANCELLED 遏制时取消；仅允许 OPEN→ACKNOWLEDGED 或 OPEN→CANCELLED',
    note VARCHAR(1024) NULL COMMENT '确认时提交的非空处置说明；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    acknowledged_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '确认人（操作当时的当前指挥人）；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '确认 UTC 时刻；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_escalation_incident UNIQUE (incident_id)
) COMMENT='遏制逾期升级记录表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_tasks (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id；每事件至多 20 个任务',
    task_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务业务键，事件内唯一；同键同内容幂等，同键不同内容冲突',
    group_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '分组编码，非空',
    title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务标题，非空',
    resource_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '执行所需资源标识，非空；派发与执行前复检均针对该资源的凭据',
    region VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务执行区域标识，非空（与时区无关）；凭据必须覆盖该区域',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：OPEN 待派发 / DISPATCHED 已派发待执行 / EXECUTING 执行中 / BLOCKED 凭据阻断 / DONE 已完成 / CANCELLED 已取消；BLOCKED 不能直接完成，须有效凭据重新派发；DONE、CANCELLED 为终态',
    created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人（创建时的当前指挥人）',
    executing_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '执行启动人（进入 EXECUTING 时的当前指挥人）；OPEN/DISPATCHED/BLOCKED 为空',
    executing_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '进入执行状态的 UTC 时刻；OPEN/DISPATCHED/BLOCKED 为空',
    done_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '完成人（操作时的当前指挥人）；仅 DONE 有值，否则为空',
    done_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '完成 UTC 时间；仅 DONE 有值，否则为空',
    cancelled_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '取消人（操作时的当前指挥人）；仅 CANCELLED 有值，否则为空',
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '取消 UTC 时间；仅 CANCELLED 有值，否则为空',
    credential_version INT NULL COMMENT '最近一次成功派发绑定的凭据版本（资源内版本号）；未派发为空，BLOCKED 时保留阻断所依据版本；重新派发后更新',
    block_reason VARCHAR(32) NULL COMMENT '阻断原因，仅 BLOCKED 有值：CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED 凭据 UTC 有效期已结束 / CREDENTIAL_REVOKED 凭据已撤销；其他状态为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_task_key UNIQUE (incident_id, task_key)
) COMMENT='事件处置任务表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_task_blockers (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属任务 id，关联 incident_tasks.id',
    blocker_incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '阻塞事件 id，关联 incidents.id；任务仅在其全部阻塞事件进入 CONTAINED/RESOLVED/CLOSED 后才可完成；每任务 0~5 条',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_task_blocker UNIQUE (task_id, blocker_incident_id)
) COMMENT='处置任务跨事件阻塞关系表（有向图边：所属任务事件 → 阻塞事件）';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_graph_lock (
    id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '固定为 1 的单行锁；创建任务时 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE 持有，串行化环检测与写入，保证并发反向依赖最终图无环'
) COMMENT='任务依赖图全局锁表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resource_credentials (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    resource_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '资源业务键；同一资源每次登记生成新版本',
    version INT NOT NULL COMMENT '资源内递增凭据版本号，从 1 开始；派发记录冻结当时版本',
    credential_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '凭据类型；派发与执行前复检要求与任务声明类型一致',
    region VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '凭据覆盖区域（与时区无关的区域标识）；必须与任务区域一致',
    expires_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '凭据 UTC 失效时刻；当前时刻 < expiresAt 才在有效期内，等于或晚于该时刻即过期',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：ACTIVE 有效（仍需结合 expiresAt 判断有效期）/ REVOKED 已撤销；仅允许 ACTIVE→REVOKED，撤销不可逆',
    created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '登记人（X-Actor-Id，须为当前指挥人）',
    revoked_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '撤销 UTC 时刻；仅 REVOKED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '登记 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_credential_version UNIQUE (resource_key, version)
) COMMENT='资源凭据版本表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resource_credential_lock (
    id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '固定为 1 的单行锁；登记凭据版本时 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE 持有，串行化版本号分配'
) COMMENT='凭据版本号全局锁表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_dispatches (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属任务 id，关联 incident_tasks.id',
    request_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发幂等键；(task_id, request_id) 唯一，同键重放首次任务与凭据版本，换资源/改参数冲突 409',
    resource_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '本次派发使用的资源（必须与任务资源一致）',
    credential_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '本次派发绑定的凭据 id，关联 resource_credentials.id',
    credential_version INT NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时的凭据版本快照；执行前复检针对该版本，历史依据不随后续版本更新改变',
    credential_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时凭据类型快照',
    region VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时凭据覆盖区域快照（与任务区域一致）',
    credential_expires_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时凭据 UTC 失效时刻快照',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：DISPATCHED 已派发待执行 / BLOCKED 执行前复检未通过 / SUPERSEDED 已被更新凭据的重新派发取代',
    block_reason VARCHAR(32) NULL COMMENT '阻断原因，仅 BLOCKED 有值：CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED 有效期已结束 / CREDENTIAL_REVOKED 已撤销；否则为空',
    dispatched_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发操作人（当时的当前指挥人）',
    dispatched_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发 UTC 时刻',
    blocked_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '阻断 UTC 时刻；仅 BLOCKED 有值，否则为空',
    superseded_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '被新派发取代的 UTC 时刻；仅 SUPERSEDED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_dispatch_request UNIQUE (task_id, request_id)
) COMMENT='任务派发与凭据版本记录表';

    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    command_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '调用方幂等键，全局唯一',
    operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作类型：takeover/transfer_initiate/transfer_accept/action/status/escalation_check/escalation_ack/task_create/task_dispatch/task_complete/task_cancel/credential_register/credential_revoke',
    request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '规范化请求参数的 SHA-256 摘要，用于同键改参检测',
    response_status INT NULL COMMENT '首次成功的 HTTP 状态码；事务提交前必写入',
    response_body MEDIUMTEXT NULL COMMENT '首次成功响应 JSON，用于同键同参重放',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_command_key UNIQUE (command_key)
) COMMENT='命令幂等键表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_escalations (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id；每事件至多一条升级记录',
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '遏制期限 UTC，接管时按等级确定，交接不重置',
    triggered_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '逾期触发检查的 UTC 时刻（当前时刻 ≥ 期限）',
    triggered_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '触发当时的当前指挥人',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：OPEN 待确认 / ACKNOWLEDGED 已确认 / CANCELLED 遏制时取消；仅允许 OPEN→ACKNOWLEDGED 或 OPEN→CANCELLED',
    note VARCHAR(1024) NULL COMMENT '确认时提交的非空处置说明；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    acknowledged_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '确认人（操作当时的当前指挥人）；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '确认 UTC 时刻；仅 ACKNOWLEDGED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_escalation_incident UNIQUE (incident_id)
) COMMENT='遏制逾期升级记录表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_tasks (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id；每事件至多 20 个任务',
    task_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务业务键，事件内唯一；同键同内容幂等，同键不同内容冲突',
    group_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '分组编码，非空',
    title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务标题，非空',
    resource_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '执行所需资源标识，非空；派发与执行前复检均针对该资源的凭据',
    region VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务执行区域标识，非空（与时区无关）；凭据必须覆盖该区域',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：OPEN 待派发 / DISPATCHED 已派发待执行 / EXECUTING 执行中 / BLOCKED 凭据阻断 / DONE 已完成 / CANCELLED 已取消；BLOCKED 不能直接完成，须有效凭据重新派发；DONE、CANCELLED 为终态',
    created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人（创建时的当前指挥人）',
    executing_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '执行启动人（进入 EXECUTING 时的当前指挥人）；OPEN/DISPATCHED/BLOCKED 为空',
    executing_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '进入执行状态的 UTC 时刻；OPEN/DISPATCHED/BLOCKED 为空',
    done_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '完成人（操作时的当前指挥人）；仅 DONE 有值，否则为空',
    done_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '完成 UTC 时间；仅 DONE 有值，否则为空',
    cancelled_by VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '取消人（操作时的当前指挥人）；仅 CANCELLED 有值，否则为空',
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '取消 UTC 时间；仅 CANCELLED 有值，否则为空',
    credential_version INT NULL COMMENT '最近一次成功派发绑定的凭据版本（资源内版本号）；未派发为空，BLOCKED 时保留阻断所依据版本；重新派发后更新',
    block_reason VARCHAR(32) NULL COMMENT '阻断原因，仅 BLOCKED 有值：CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED 凭据 UTC 有效期已结束 / CREDENTIAL_REVOKED 凭据已撤销；其他状态为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_task_key UNIQUE (incident_id, task_key)
) COMMENT='事件处置任务表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_task_blockers (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属任务 id，关联 incident_tasks.id',
    blocker_incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '阻塞事件 id，关联 incidents.id；任务仅在其全部阻塞事件进入 CONTAINED/RESOLVED/CLOSED 后才可完成；每任务 0~5 条',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_task_blocker UNIQUE (task_id, blocker_incident_id)
) COMMENT='处置任务跨事件阻塞关系表（有向图边：所属任务事件 → 阻塞事件）';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_graph_lock (
    id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '固定为 1 的单行锁；创建任务时 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE 持有，串行化环检测与写入，保证并发反向依赖最终图无环'
) COMMENT='任务依赖图全局锁表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resource_credentials (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    resource_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '资源业务键；同一资源每次登记生成新版本',
    version INT NOT NULL COMMENT '资源内递增凭据版本号，从 1 开始；派发记录冻结当时版本',
    credential_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '凭据类型；派发与执行前复检要求与任务声明类型一致',
    region VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '凭据覆盖区域（与时区无关的区域标识）；必须与任务区域一致',
    expires_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '凭据 UTC 失效时刻；当前时刻 < expiresAt 才在有效期内，等于或晚于该时刻即过期',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：ACTIVE 有效（仍需结合 expiresAt 判断有效期）/ REVOKED 已撤销；仅允许 ACTIVE→REVOKED，撤销不可逆',
    created_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '登记人（X-Actor-Id，须为当前指挥人）',
    revoked_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '撤销 UTC 时刻；仅 REVOKED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '登记 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_credential_version UNIQUE (resource_key, version)
) COMMENT='资源凭据版本表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resource_credential_lock (
    id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '固定为 1 的单行锁；登记凭据版本时 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE 持有，串行化版本号分配'
) COMMENT='凭据版本号全局锁表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_dispatches (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属任务 id，关联 incident_tasks.id',
    request_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发幂等键；(task_id, request_id) 唯一，同键重放首次任务与凭据版本，换资源/改参数冲突 409',
    resource_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '本次派发使用的资源（必须与任务资源一致）',
    credential_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '本次派发绑定的凭据 id，关联 resource_credentials.id',
    credential_version INT NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时的凭据版本快照；执行前复检针对该版本，历史依据不随后续版本更新改变',
    credential_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时凭据类型快照',
    region VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时凭据覆盖区域快照（与任务区域一致）',
    credential_expires_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发当时凭据 UTC 失效时刻快照',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：DISPATCHED 已派发待执行 / BLOCKED 执行前复检未通过 / SUPERSEDED 已被更新凭据的重新派发取代',
    block_reason VARCHAR(32) NULL COMMENT '阻断原因，仅 BLOCKED 有值：CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED 有效期已结束 / CREDENTIAL_REVOKED 已撤销；否则为空',
    dispatched_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发操作人（当时的当前指挥人）',
    dispatched_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '派发 UTC 时刻',
    blocked_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '阻断 UTC 时刻；仅 BLOCKED 有值，否则为空',
    superseded_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '被新派发取代的 UTC 时刻；仅 SUPERSEDED 有值，否则为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_dispatch_request UNIQUE (task_id, request_id)
) COMMENT='任务派发与凭据版本记录表';

-- 事件指挥本地持久化 schema（MySQL 8）。
-- 所有时间字段均为 UTC，精度到微秒；为空含义见各字段 COMMENT。

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件业务键，全局唯一',
    severity VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL COMMENT '严重等级，取值 S1~S4',
    summary VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件摘要',
    reporter VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '上报人标识',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：REPORTED/COMMANDING/CONTAINED/RESOLVED/CLOSED，仅允许单向逐级流转',
    commander VARCHAR(128) NULL COMMENT '当前指挥人（X-Actor-Id）；REPORTED 状态为空表示尚未接管',
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '遏制期限 UTC；首次进入 COMMANDING 时按接管时刻加等级时限确定，S1=5分钟/S2=15分钟/S3=60分钟/S4=240分钟，交接不重置；REPORTED 为空',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '最近变更 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_incidents_key UNIQUE (incident_key)
) COMMENT='事件主表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_actions (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    action_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置记录业务键，事件内唯一；同键同内容幂等，同键不同内容冲突',
    action_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置类型，由调用方定义',
    note VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置说明',
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '处置发生的 UTC 时间（客户端上报）',
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作人（提交时的当前指挥人）',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '服务端落库 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_action_key UNIQUE (incident_id, action_key)
) COMMENT='事件处置记录表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_transfers (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    from_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '发起人（发起时的当前指挥人）',
    to_commander VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '目标指挥人，必须与发起人不同',
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态：PENDING 待接受 / ACCEPTED 已接受；同一事件至多一条 PENDING',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '发起 UTC 时间',
    accepted_at TIMESTAMP(6) NULL COMMENT '接受 UTC 时间；仅 ACCEPTED 有值，否则为空'
) COMMENT='指挥交接单表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_status_history (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id',
    from_status VARCHAR(16) NULL COMMENT '流转前状态；事件创建记录为空',
    to_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '流转后状态',
    actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作人；事件创建时为上报人',
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '流转发生 UTC 时间'
) COMMENT='事件状态流转历史表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS command_keys (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    command_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '调用方幂等键，全局唯一',
    operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '操作类型：takeover/transfer_initiate/transfer_accept/action/status/escalation_check/escalation_ack/task_create/task_complete/task_cancel',
    request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '规范化请求参数的 SHA-256 摘要，用于同键改参检测',
    response_status INT NULL COMMENT '首次成功的 HTTP 状态码；事务提交前必写入',
    response_body MEDIUMTEXT NULL COMMENT '首次成功响应 JSON，用于同键同参重放',
    created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '创建 UTC 时间',
    CONSTRAINT uk_command_key UNIQUE (command_key)
) COMMENT='命令幂等键表';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incident_escalations (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '自增主键',
    incident_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '所属事件 id，关联 incidents.id；每事件至多一条升级记录',
    deadline_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL COMMENT '遏制期限 UTC，接管时按等级确定，交接不重置',

构建与全部测试通过。下面给出交付说明。

## 已完成的改动

**数据模型（3 份 schema 同步：`schema-h2.sql`、`schema.sql`(MySQL 注释版)、测试 `schema.sql`）**
- 新增 `resource_credentials`（资源凭据版本表，`(resource_key, version)` 唯一，含类型/区域/UTC 失效时刻/ACTIVE·REVOKED/撤销时刻）、`resource_credential_lock`（版本号单行锁）、`task_dispatches`（派发记录表，`(task_id, request_id)` 唯一，冻结派发当时凭据版本/类型/区域/失效时刻快照）。
- `incident_tasks` 增加 `resource_key`、`region`、`credential_version`、`block_reason`、`executing_by/at`；状态机扩展为 `OPEN→DISPATCHED→EXECUTING→DONE`，复检失败 `DISPATCHED/EXECUTING→BLOCKED`，`BLOCKED→DISPATCHED`（重新派发），非终态可 `CANCELLED`。

**核心逻辑（`IncidentService`/`IncidentController` + 新仓储）**
- 凭据登记（版本自增）、撤销（条件更新仅 ACTIVE，不可逆）、查询。
- 派发：取最新已提交凭据版本，校验**类型一致、覆盖任务区域、ACTIVE、当前 UTC < expiresAt**，通过则冻结版本写派发记录；失败 409 不留记录。重新派发把旧待执行记录置 `SUPERSEDED`，旧凭据不会自动解锁。
- 执行前复检：对冻结版本 `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`，撤销→`BLOCKED/CREDENTIAL_REVOKED`，过期→`BLOCKED/CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED`；BLOCKED 不能直接完成，须更新凭据后用**新 requestId** 重新派发。
- 幂等：`commandKey` 沿用原机制；派发 `(task, requestId)` 同键同参重放首次任务与凭据版本，换资源/改类型 409。
- 并发：事件行锁 + 凭据版本行锁 + 状态条件更新（`WHERE status=…`，0 行即被并发抢先），撤销/执行启动只按已提交凭据状态裁决。
- 查询（任务明细/列表）返回状态、凭据版本、阻断原因及全部派发记录；历史记录保留当时区域与凭据版本。

**测试（真实 H2 `MODE=MySQL`，无 Docker/外部库）**：新增 `CredentialDispatchServiceTest`（7 例，含可控时钟的 11:59 派发→12:00 BLOCKED→更新凭据再派发主场景、撤销阻断、类型/区域/到期边界、requestId 幂等、撤销与执行并发裁决、并发单次转移），并改造 3 个既有任务测试 + `SchemaH2ScriptTest` 约束验证。

## 结果（如实）
- `./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain classes`：BUILD SUCCESSFUL
- `./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain test`：**72 通过 / 0 失败 / 0 跳过 / 0 错误**（11 个测试类）
- `./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain build`：BUILD SUCCESSFUL

过程中修复了两个真实问题：`ResultSet.wasNull()` 因列读取顺序把非空 `credential_version` 误判为 NULL；以及一个测试误把全局共享凭据当成按事件隔离。H2 已验证唯一约束、回滚、条件状态更新与并发写入；**未在 MySQL 上验证**（环境无 MySQL，且不使用 Docker）。

## 命令与合成调用

本地启动（H2 内存库，自动建表，状态仅本 JVM 有效）：
```bash
./gradlew bootRun
```
标准测试：
```bash
./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain test
```

合成业务调用（资源 R 凭据覆盖区域 A，有效期给到未来时刻）：
```bash
# 1) 登记凭据 v1（预期 201，version=1,status=ACTIVE）
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/incidents/credentials -H 'X-Actor-Id: alice' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"commandKey":"c1","resourceKey":"RES-R","credentialType":"TOKEN","region":"A","expiresAt":"2026-10-01T02:00:00Z"}'
# 2) 上报+接管+建任务（预期任务 status=OPEN）
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/incidents -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"incidentKey":"INC-1","severity":"S2","summary":"s","reporter":"r"}'
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/incidents/INC-1/takeover -H 'X-Actor-Id: alice' -d '{"commandKey":"c2"}'
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/incidents/INC-1/tasks -H 'X-Actor-Id: alice' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"commandKey":"c3","taskKey":"T-1","groupCode":"NET","title":"切换","resourceKey":"RES-R","region":"A","blockerIncidentKeys":[]}'
# 3) 派发（预期 status=DISPATCHED, credentialVersion=1）
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/incidents/INC-1/tasks/T-1/dispatch -H 'X-Actor-Id: alice' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"requestId":"REQ-1","resourceKey":"RES-R","credentialType":"TOKEN"}'
# 4) 执行前检查（预期 status=EXECUTING）
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/incidents/INC-1/tasks/T-1/execute -H 'X-Actor-Id: alice' -d '{"commandKey":"c4"}'
# 5) 完成并查询（预期 DONE；dispatches[0].credentialVersion=1、region=A 保持当时快照）
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/api/incidents/INC-1/tasks/T-1/complete -H 'X-Actor-Id: alice' -d '{"commandKey":"c5"}'
curl -s localhost:8080/api/incidents/INC-1/tasks/T-1
```
若在执行前把 v1 撤销（`POST /api/incidents/credentials/revoke`）或等到 `expiresAt`，第 4 步将返回 `status=BLOCKED`、`blockReason=CREDENTIAL_REVOKED|CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED`、`credentialVersion=1`，且 complete 返回 409；登记有效 v2 后用新 requestId 重新派发即可继续。
